topic: 情态动词进阶：规则、许可与建议 (Modal Verbs: Rules, Permissions, and Advice)
teaching_notes: 同学们好！今天我们来认识几位爱“立规矩”和“提建议”的情态动词小伙伴。当表达必须遵守的校规、法律或绝对必要的事情时，用 must 或 have to；当表达严厉禁止做某事时用 mustn't（千万别做！），而表示“没有必要做”时则用 don't/doesn't have to（做不做随你，但别搞混哦！）。若是想给同伴一个贴心、友善的建议，用 should 或 shouldn't 最得体。最重要的是：情态动词身后永远只跟动词原形（Base Form）！例句：You must wear a helmet when riding a bike.（骑自行车必须戴头盔。）You look tired; you should go to bed early.（你看起来很累，应该早点睡。）

questions.question: Shh! This is a library. You _____ shout or speak loudly here.
questions.explanation: 图书馆内禁止大声喧哗，表示严格禁止用 mustn't。

questions.question: Tomorrow is Sunday, so we _____ get up early. We can sleep until 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: 周日不用早起，表示“不必做某事/没有必要”用 don't have to。

questions.question: You look very pale and have a high fever. You _____ go see the school nurse right now.
questions.explanation: 同学发烧了，给出合理的关怀建议使用 should（应该）。

questions.question: Look at the red traffic light! All drivers _____ stop their cars immediately.
questions.explanation: 红灯亮起，司机必须停车，这是交通法规强制要求，用 must。

questions.question: Please remember that all students must _____ their hands before asking a question in class.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must 后面必须加动词原形 raise。

questions.question: Peter: 'Mr. Davis, _____ I drink some water? It's very hot.' Mr. Davis: 'Of course you may.'
questions.explanation: 向老师礼貌请求许可，通常使用 May I...?

questions.question: The museum ticket says: 'Visitors _____ touch the ancient paintings.' It is strictly forbidden.
questions.explanation: 严禁触摸展品，表示绝对禁止用 mustn't。

questions.question: My elder brother is an adult, but he _____ study hard because he has an important test next week.
questions.explanation: 主语是第三人称单数 he，且表示有必要做某事，用 has to。

questions.question: You _____ eat too much junk food before dinner, or you won't be able to finish your vegetables.
questions.explanation: 晚饭前不应该吃太多零食，这是健康建议，用 shouldn't。

questions.question: We _____ bring our own lunch to school because the school cafeteria provides free meals for everyone.
questions.explanation: 学校提供免费午餐，因此我们“不必”自备午餐，用 don't have to。

questions.question: Lucy _____ wear her glasses when reading books, otherwise her eyes will hurt.
questions.explanation: 根据上下文语境，露西看书时“应该”戴眼镜，用 should。

questions.question: Danger! You _____ swim in this river because the water is deep and full of rocks.
questions.explanation: 危险警示，绝对禁止在此游泳，用 mustn't。

questions.question: '_____ we have to bring our art aprons tomorrow?' asked Tim.
questions.explanation: have to 的一般疑问句需要借助助动词 do/does，主语是 we，故用 Do we have to...?

questions.question: The floor in the science lab is wet and slippery. You _____ walk slowly and carefully.
questions.explanation: 地面湿滑，必须慢行注意安全，表示强烈必要性用 must。

questions.question: Sam: 'I already washed the dishes.' Mom: 'Thank you, Sam! Then you _____ do any more chores tonight.'
questions.explanation: 碗已经洗过了，今晚就“不需要/不必”再做家务了，用 don't have to。

questions.question: Students _____ cheat on exams. If caught, they will receive a zero mark.
questions.explanation: 严禁作弊，校规红线，使用表示禁止的 mustn't。

questions.question: Lily feels very tired today. She _____ stay up late watching cartoons tonight.
questions.explanation: 莉莉很累了，今晚不应该熬夜看动画片，用 shouldn't 表达合理建议。

questions.question: At our school, every student _____ wear a white shirt and navy shorts for sports day.
questions.explanation: every student 是单数概念，表示规定必须穿校服，用 has to。

questions.question: You _____ feed the monkeys in the national park. Wild animals can become aggressive.
questions.explanation: 公园规定严禁喂食野生动物，用绝对禁止的 mustn't。

questions.question: When you receive a lovely birthday gift from your friend, you _____ always say 'Thank you'.
questions.explanation: 礼貌待人，收到礼物应当说谢谢，用 should 表达行为建议。

questions.question: Mark has a free bus pass, so he _____ pay for the bus ticket.
questions.explanation: 有免费乘车卡，所以马克“不必”付车费。Mark 为第三人称单数，用 doesn't have to。

questions.question: To keep our teeth healthy and strong, we should _____ our teeth twice a day.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should 后面必须使用动词原形 brush。

questions.question: Passengers _____ show their passports and boarding passes before boarding the plane.
questions.explanation: 乘客登机前必须出示护照和登机牌，passengers 是复数，用 have to。

questions.question: Sign on the lawn: 'Keep off the grass! People _____ walk on it.'
questions.explanation: 警示牌提示严禁践踏草坪，用表示禁止的 mustn't。

questions.question: Ben: '_____ I borrow your colored pencils for this poster?' Ella: 'Sure, here you are!'
questions.explanation: 同学之间礼貌请求借用文具，用 Can I...?

questions.question: You _____ run around the swimming pool. The ground is wet and you might slip and fall.
questions.explanation: 泳池边奔跑极其危险，泳池安全守则禁止奔跑，用 mustn't。

questions.question: Jenny doesn't have homework tonight, so she _____ worry about finishing any exercises.
questions.explanation: 今晚没有作业，所以她“不需要/不必”担心，用 doesn't have to。

questions.question: When crossing the street, children _____ always look left and right carefully.
questions.explanation: 过马路时必须左右看，安全基本守则，用 must。

questions.question: You _____ be rude to your teachers and classmates. Politeness is very important.
questions.explanation: 不应该对老师和同学无礼，用 shouldn't 提出道德与行为建议。

questions.question: The concert is completely free for children. Parents _____ buy tickets for them.
questions.explanation: 音乐会对儿童完全免费，父母“不必”给他们买票，用 don't have to。
